mandatoryCriteria: Access summary disclosure: Discloses project role and board inheritance model (boards inherit project grants)
Workspace owner resolution: Workspace owner actor role is reported as owner with inherited = true
Sibling and outsider isolation: Non-members querying project access summary receive 404 NOT_FOUND without metadata leakage
Authentication enforcement: Unauthenticated requests receive 401 UNAUTHORIZED
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Project access summary endpoint, role inheritance disclosure, and privacy boundary. Out-of-scope: Custom permission overrides per board.
